verdict.rationale: Svelte is a locally run, open-source compiler, so a user's work already lives in their own project files. Its output is plain HTML, JS and CSS (svelte-docs-37, svelte-docs-4). The one hosted surface where user data could sit, the playground, has a documented CLI path that downloads all playground files into a complete SvelteKit project (svelte-docs-15). missing for 10: an explicit data-export or account-portability feature, confirmation that all hosted user data (e.g. every saved playground) can be exported in bulk, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the playground export.
